name: How much backsplash do I need in a modern kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: How much backsplash coverage makes sense in a modern luxury kitchen without overdoing it?
mainEntity.text: How much backsplash coverage makes sense in a modern luxury kitchen without overdoing it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Backsplash coverage should be chosen based on both function and style. In many modern luxury kitchens, homeowners extend tile or slab backsplash to the underside of the upper cabinets for a clean, continuous look and better protection against splashes. Some designs go full height to the ceiling or to a focal point wall, especially when using stone slab or statement tile. The right amount depends on how much wall protection the kitchen needs behind the sink, range, and prep areas, as well as how the backsplash will coordinate with the countertop and cabinetry. A smaller backsplash can feel more traditional, while a taller installation often creates a more custom look. Homeowners should also consider grout lines, maintenance, and visual balance. The best choice is the one that fits the design language of the kitchen and supports daily use without feeling excessive.
acceptedAnswer.description: Backsplash coverage depends on the design style, countertop material, and how much wall protection is needed behind the sink and cooking areas. Many modern kitchens extend the backsplash to the bottom of the upper cabinets or full height for a cleaner look.
